narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On January 9, 2024, at approximately 0450 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] were watching the shoreline of the St. Clair River near Marine City, Michigan, when they saw a man come ashore from a small inflatable boat. The agents identified themselves and asked him where he was a citizen.
The man, the subject of this report, stated that he is a national of Mexico and carried no papers of any kind. He stated that he had been living in Canada and that, minutes earlier, he had paddled across the river from Ontario to avoid the port of entry at the Blue Water Bridge.
TRAVEL:
He stated that he intended to take a bus to Chicago.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
He was issued a Notice to Appear (Form I-862) and released on his own recognizance (Form I-220A).
